feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day weather forecast

items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 2 June 2026 6:28am
items.description:
##Today##

Low cloud, mist & fog patches affecting mainly southern to eastern parts of the island this morning, as well as some outbreaks of rain, heavy at times soon arriving. The afternoon and evening will then become generally drier and brighter, although still with the risk of some scattered showers, possibly heavy at times.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 11°C and max. air temperature 18°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

2-5


##Wind Speed##

15


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

Mainly W or SW 10-15, but variable 10 or less in places, increasing 15-20 this evening, before backing S or SW overnight.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, falling poor or very poor in mist/fog at first. Hill fog soon becoming isolated.


##Comments##

Nil.


##Tomorrow##

Outbreaks of rain, potentially heavy, soon arriving in the morning, then clearing to scattered showers in the afternoon.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 10°C and max. air temperature 16°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

4-12


##Wind Speed##

23


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

S or SW 15-20, soon backing S or SE 15-25, veering SW in the afternoon.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain/showers. Hill fog becoming isolated later.


##Comments##

Strong winds soon developing.


##Thursday, 4 June 2026##

Cloudy with occasional rain or showers.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 9°C and max. air temperature 15°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

4-10


##Wind Speed##

22


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

SW 15-20, soon veering W or SW, increasing 15-25.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain or showers. Hill fog at times.


##Comments##

Strong winds developing.


##Friday, 5 June 2026##

Sunny spells with the risk of showers, mostly isolated.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 10°C and max. air temperature 14°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

1-5


##Wind Speed##

20


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

W or SW 20-25, soon decreasing S or SW 15-20, then 10-15 in the afternoon. Backing S or SE later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in showers. Isolated hill fog patches.


##Comments##

Strong winds until later.


##Saturday, 6 June 2026##

Cloudy and often fair, with the small risk of some occasional outbreaks of rain at times.


##Temperature##

12

Nil.
